symptom: `alter page … set (DataSource: microflow M.DS(Dag = [%BeginOfCurrentDay%])) on dataView2` replaced the source but dropped the argument: describe printed `microflow M.DS`, mx check failed CE1571 'No argument has been selected for parameter Dag'. check reported nothing.
cause: Two drops: convertASTDataSource built the MicroflowSource/NanoflowSource without ds.Args, and the page mutator's own serializeDataSourceBson wrote ParameterMappings empty (and FormValidations All) whatever it was given.
fix: convertASTDataSource maps the arguments with create page's flowArgsToParameterMappings (through an alter page builder), and the mutator writes a flow source through a new Deps.SerializeFormDataSource, backed by create page's dataViewSourceToGen / listViewSourceToGen; its own serializer stays as the fallback.
insight: A second serializer for the same element in the mutator is where fields go missing: this one hard-coded two properties. Routing the write through the create path's serializer fixes the whole class; a hand-written bson.D in pagemutator is the smell to grep for.
test: mdl/executor/alter_set_datasource_args_2634_test.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/form_datasource_args_2634_test.go; the executor test failed to compile before (no args path). Live 11.12.6: the issue's set stores Dag = [%BeginOfCurrentDay%], describe prints it, re-run unchanged, mx check 0 errors.
